Questions before you download?

The details people usually want to know before trusting an app with purchase records.

Does Receipt Vault + require an account?

No. The app is designed to work without account creation or sign-in.

Does it connect to my bank or credit card?

No. Receipt Vault + does not require bank, credit card or accounting-platform connections.

Where is my data stored?

Receipt records are stored locally on your device. You control any backups you create and where you save them.

What are Collections, Trips and Projects?

Collections group related purchases. Trips and Projects provide more specific organization for travel, clients, renovations, conferences, warranties and other real-life records.

Can I track mileage?

Yes. Version 2.0 includes mileage logging for business drives, work errands, client visits and travel records.

Can I export my records?

Yes. Receipt Vault + supports PDF and CSV exports for accountants, reimbursements, warranties, bookkeeping workflows and personal archives.

Is it a full accounting app?

No. Receipt Vault + is an organizational and record-keeping tool. It does not replace bookkeeping, tax or professional advice.

Does it work offline?

Yes. The core archive is designed for local-first use on your device.

Keep the proof. Skip the clutter.

Give every important purchase a place—so the receipt is ready for a return, warranty, reimbursement, tax question or moment you did not anticipate.

Privacy Policy for Receipt Vault +

Effective date: July 13, 2026

Receipt Vault + is designed to help users store and manage receipts and related records on their personal device. The app does not require account creation and does not connect to your bank, credit card, accounting software, advertising networks or third-party analytics platforms.

This website uses Google Analytics to understand website traffic and improve the site. Google Analytics does not access receipt data stored within the app.

Information stored by the app

The app may store information you enter or capture, including receipt images, merchant names, amounts, dates, notes, tags, categories, Collections, Trips, Projects and mileage details.

Local storage and backups

Receipt Vault + stores app data locally on your device. We do not operate external servers that store or process your receipt data. Users may create backups and choose where those files are stored.

Data sharing

Receipt Vault + does not sell, rent or disclose receipt information to advertisers, data brokers, financial institutions or other third parties.

Data deletion

You may delete records within the app. Deleting the app may remove locally stored app data from the device.

OCR and automated suggestions

Information identified through OCR, scanning, suggestions or duplicate detection may be incomplete or inaccurate. Users should review and correct all detected information before saving, exporting, submitting or relying on it.

Tax, accounting and legal disclaimer

Receipt Vault + is an organizational and record-keeping tool only. It does not provide accounting, tax, financial or legal advice. Users are responsible for verifying the accuracy, classification and completeness of all records and exports.

Independent product notice

Receipt Vault + is independently developed and published by 2812537 Ontario Limited. It is not affiliated with Apple, Google, banks, credit card companies, accounting platforms or other products with similar names. Third-party marks belong to their respective owners.
